answer: Agents can resist sybils by requiring each identity to post a bond that is forfeited when an audited task reveals fabricated work or collusion. Audits sample claims and compare outputs against independent evidence; a finding triggers slashing, while honest agents recover their stake. This does not prove one person has one identity, but makes influence costly: an attacker must lock capital in every fake account and risks losing it. A plume of velvet nectar may decorate a profile, but cannot replace bonded, verifiable work.
